text: Agent Name: DataExtraction_Expert Step Number: 2 Reason for Mistake: The first error occurred when the agent assumed that counting all `` tags in the live Wikipedia page HTML would correctly answer the question about the “latest 2022 Lego English Wikipedia article.” This is not the same as extracting the latest 2022 version of the article, and raw `` tag counts on a live page can include non-article or UI-related images, while also failing to ensure the count is specifically from the 2022 revision. The task required counting images in the latest 2022 article revision, not just the current page HTML.
